translations.literal: Those not holding court office were all Direct Associates.
translations.idiomatic: those not holding court office were all Direct Associates.

sentences.zh: 大中八年，廢史館直館二員，增脩撰四人，分掌四季。

translations.literal: In Dazhong 8, two Historiography Office Direct Associate posts were abolished and four Compilers added, each managing one season.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong 8 two Historiography Office Direct Associate posts were abolished and four Compilers added, each managing one season.

sentences.zh: 有令史二人，楷書十二人，寫國史楷書十八人，楷書手二十五人，典書二人，亭長二人，掌固四人，熟紙匠六人。

translations.literal: There were two Clerks, twelve Regular Script copyists, eighteen Regular Script copyists for the national history, twenty-five Regular Script scribes, two archive keepers, two station chiefs, four watchmen, and six paper-preparation craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The office had two Clerks, twelve Regular Script copyists, eighteen Regular Script copyists for the national history, twenty-five Regular Script scribes, two archive keepers, two station chiefs, four watchmen, and six paper-preparation craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 祕書省監一人，從三品；

translations.literal: One Imperial Library Director, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Library had one Director, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 少監二人，從四品上；

translations.literal: two Vice Directors, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Vice Directors, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從五品上。

translations.literal: one Assistant Director, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one Assistant Director, ranked at upper fifth grade.

sentences.zh: 監掌經籍圖書之事，領著作局，少監為之貳。

translations.literal: The Director managed classics, records, and books, headed the Composition Bureau, and the Vice Directors assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The Director managed the classics, records, and books, headed the Composition Bureau, and the Vice Directors assisted him.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，改少令曰少監。

translations.literal: In Wude 4, Vice Commissioner was renamed Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 the Vice Commissioner was renamed Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改祕書省曰蘭臺，監曰太史，少監曰侍郎，丞曰大夫，祕書郎曰蘭臺郎。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Imperial Library was renamed the Orchid Terrace, the Director the Grand Astrologer, the Vice Director the Vice Minister, the Assistant Director the Grand Master, and the Library Director the Orchid Terrace Director.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Imperial Library was renamed the Orchid Terrace, the Director became the Grand Astrologer, the Vice Director the Vice Minister, the Assistant Director the Grand Master, and the Library Director the Orchid Terrace Director.

sentences.zh: 武后垂拱元年，祕書省曰麟臺；

translations.literal: In Chuigong 1 under Empress Wu, the Imperial Library was called the Qilin Terrace;
translations.idiomatic: In Chuigong 1 under Empress Wu the Imperial Library was called the Qilin Terrace;

sentences.zh: 太極元年曰祕書省。

translations.literal: In Taiji 1 it was called the Imperial Library.
translations.idiomatic: in Taiji 1 it was again called the Imperial Library.

sentences.zh: 有典書四人，楷書十人，令史四人，書令史九人，亭長六人，掌固八人，熟紙匠十人，裝潢匠十人，筆匠六人。

translations.literal: There were four archive keepers, ten Regular Script copyists, four Clerks, nine Recording Clerks, six station chiefs, eight watchmen, ten paper-preparation craftsmen, ten mounting craftsmen, and six brush makers.
translations.idiomatic: The office had four archive keepers, ten Regular Script copyists, four Clerks, nine Recording Clerks, six station chiefs, eight watchmen, ten paper-preparation craftsmen, ten mounting craftsmen, and six brush makers.

sentences.zh: 祕書郎三人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Three Library Directors, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were three Library Directors, ranked at upper sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌四部圖籍。

translations.literal: They managed the four categories of maps and records.
translations.idiomatic: They managed the four categories of maps and records.

sentences.zh: 以甲乙丙丁為部，皆有三本，一曰正，二曰副，三曰貯。

translations.literal: Using jia, yi, bing, and ding as categories, each had three copies: first the master copy, second the duplicate, third the reserve.
translations.idiomatic: The categories were jia, yi, bing, and ding; each had three copies—the master copy, the duplicate, and the reserve.

sentences.zh: 凡課寫功程，皆分判。

translations.literal: All copying quotas and work schedules were divided for adjudication.
translations.idiomatic: All copying quotas and work schedules were divided among them for adjudication.

sentences.zh: 校書郎十人，正九品上；

translations.literal: Ten Text Collators, upper ninth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were ten Text Collators, ranked at upper ninth grade;

sentences.zh: 正字四人，正九品下。

translations.literal: four Proofreaders, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and four Proofreaders, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌讎校典籍，刊正文章。

translations.literal: They managed proofreading of classics and correction of texts.
translations.idiomatic: They proofread the classics and corrected textual errors.

sentences.zh: 著作局郎二人，從五品上；

translations.literal: Two Composition Bureau Directors, upper fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Composition Bureau had two Directors, ranked at upper fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 著作佐郎二人，從六品上；

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Assistant Directors, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 校書郎二人，正九品上；

translations.literal: two Text Collators, upper ninth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Text Collators, ranked at upper ninth grade;

sentences.zh: 正字二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: two Proofreaders, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Proofreaders, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 著作郎掌撰碑誌、祝文、祭文，與佐郎分判局事。

translations.literal: The Composition Bureau Director managed drafting of stele inscriptions, prayer texts, and sacrificial texts, and divided bureau affairs with the Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Composition Bureau Director drafted stele inscriptions, prayer texts, and sacrificial texts, and divided bureau affairs with the Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，改著作曹曰局。

translations.literal: In Wude 4, the Composition Section was renamed the Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 the Composition Section was renamed the Bureau.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，曰司文局；

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, it was called the Bureau of Written Documents;
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 it was called the Bureau of Written Documents;

sentences.zh: 郎曰郎中，佐郎曰司文郎。

translations.literal: the Director became Bureau Director, the Assistant Director the Document Director.
translations.idiomatic: the Director became Bureau Director and the Assistant Director the Document Director.

sentences.zh: 有楷書五人，書令史一人，書吏二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were five Regular Script copyists, one Recording Clerk, two document clerks, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had five Regular Script copyists, one Recording Clerk, two document clerks, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 司天臺監一人，正三品；

translations.literal: One Bureau of Astronomy Director, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Astronomy had one Director, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 少監二人，正四品上；

translations.literal: two Vice Directors, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Vice Directors, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正六品上；

translations.literal: one Assistant Director, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: one Assistant Director, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，正七品上；

translations.literal: two Chief Clerks, upper seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Chief Clerks, ranked at upper seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 主事一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: one Section Chief, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one Section Chief, ranked at lower eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 監掌察天文，稽曆數。

translations.literal: The Director observed the heavens and verified calendrical reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: The Director observed the heavens and verified calendrical reckoning.

sentences.zh: 凡日月星辰、風雲氣色之異，率其屬而占。

translations.literal: For all anomalies of sun, moon, stars, wind, clouds, and atmospheric colors, he led his subordinates in divination.
translations.idiomatic: For all anomalies of the sun, moon, stars, wind, clouds, and atmospheric colors, he led his subordinates in interpreting them.

sentences.zh: 有通玄院，以藝學召至京師者居之。

translations.literal: There was a Court of Universal Mystery, where those summoned to the capital for technical learning resided.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Court of Universal Mystery, where those summoned to the capital for technical learning resided.

sentences.zh: 凡天文圖書、器物，非其任不得與焉。

translations.literal: All astronomical books, records, and instruments—those not charged with the duty could not have access.
translations.idiomatic: All astronomical books, records, and instruments were restricted to those charged with the duty; no one else could have access.

sentences.zh: 每季錄祥眚送門下、中書省，紀于起居注，歲終上送史館。

translations.literal: Each quarter auspicious and inauspicious signs were recorded and sent to the Chancellery and Secretariat, entered in the Diaries of Activity and Rest, and at year's end submitted to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: Each quarter auspicious and inauspicious signs were recorded and sent to the Chancellery and Secretariat, entered in the Diaries of Activity and Rest, and at year's end submitted to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 歲頒曆于天下。

translations.literal: Each year the calendar was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the calendar was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，改太史監曰太史局，隸祕書省；

translations.literal: In Wude 4, the Grand Astrologer's Office was renamed the Astrology Bureau and placed under the Imperial Library;
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 the Grand Astrologer's Office was renamed the Astrology Bureau and placed under the Imperial Library;

sentences.zh: 七年，廢監候。

translations.literal: in year 7, Observation Masters were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: in year 7 the Observation Masters were abolished.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改太史局曰祕書閣局，令曰祕書閣郎中。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Library Pavilion Bureau and the Commissioner the Library Pavilion Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Library Pavilion Bureau and the Commissioner became the Library Pavilion Bureau Director.

sentences.zh: 武后光宅元年，改太史局曰渾天監，不隸麟臺；

translations.literal: In Guangzhai 1 under Empress Wu, the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Celestial Sphere Office and no longer subordinate to the Qilin Terrace;
translations.idiomatic: In Guangzhai 1 under Empress Wu the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Celestial Sphere Office and was no longer subordinate to the Qilin Terrace;

sentences.zh: 俄改曰渾儀監，置副監及丞、主簿，改司辰師曰司辰。

translations.literal: Soon it was renamed the Armillary Sphere Office; Vice Directors, Assistant Directors, and Chief Clerks were established, and Timekeepers were renamed Time Regulators.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was renamed the Armillary Sphere Office; Vice Directors, Assistant Directors, and Chief Clerks were appointed, and Timekeepers were renamed Time Regulators.

sentences.zh: 長安二年，渾儀監復曰太史局，廢副監及丞，隸麟臺如故，改天文博士曰靈臺郎，曆博士曰保章正。

translations.literal: In Chang'an 2, the Armillary Sphere Office was again the Astrology Bureau; Vice Directors and Assistant Directors were abolished and it was again subordinate to the Qilin Terrace; Astronomy Masters were renamed Spirit Terrace Directors and Calendar Masters Calendar Rectifiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Chang'an 2 the Armillary Sphere Office again became the Astrology Bureau; Vice Directors and Assistant Directors were abolished and it was again subordinate to the Qilin Terrace; Astronomy Masters became Spirit Terrace Directors and Calendar Masters became Calendar Rectifiers.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，改太史局曰太史監，不隸祕書省，復置丞。

translations.literal: In Jinglong 2, the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Grand Astrologer's Office, no longer subordinate to the Imperial Library, and the Assistant Director was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Jinglong 2 the Astrology Bureau was renamed the Grand Astrologer's Office, was no longer subordinate to the Imperial Library, and the Assistant Director was restored.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年，又為局，隸祕書省，踰月為監，歲中復為局；

translations.literal: In Jingyun 1, it again became a bureau subordinate to the Imperial Library; after a month it became an office, and midyear again a bureau;
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyun 1 it again became a bureau subordinate to the Imperial Library; after a month it became an office, and midyear it became a bureau again;

sentences.zh: 二年，改曰渾儀監。

translations.literal: in year 2 it was renamed the Armillary Sphere Office.
translations.idiomatic: in year 2 it was renamed the Armillary Sphere Office.

sentences.zh: 開元二年，復曰太史監，改令為監，置少監。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan 2, it was again the Grand Astrologer's Office; the Commissioner became Director and Vice Directors were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 2 it was again the Grand Astrologer's Office; the Commissioner became Director and Vice Directors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，太史監復為局，以監為令，而廢少監。

translations.literal: In year 14, the Grand Astrologer's Office again became a bureau; the Director became Commissioner and Vice Directors were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 the Grand Astrologer's Office again became a bureau; the Director became Commissioner and the Vice Directors were abolished.

sentences.zh: 天寶元年，太史局復為監，自是不隸祕書省。

translations.literal: In Tianbao 1, the Astrology Bureau again became an office, and from then on was not subordinate to the Imperial Library.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 1 the Astrology Bureau again became an office, and from then on was not subordinate to the Imperial Library.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，曰司天臺。

translations.literal: In Qianyuan 1, it was called the Bureau of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyuan 1 it was called the Bureau of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 藝術人韓潁、劉烜建議改令為監，置通玄院及主簿，置五官監候及五官禮生十五人，掌布諸壇神位，五官楷書手五人，掌寫御書。

translations.literal: Technical specialists Han Ying and Liu Xuan proposed changing Commissioner to Director, establishing the Court of Universal Mystery and Chief Clerks, establishing five Observation Masters and fifteen Ritual Attendants of the Five Offices to arrange spirit seats at the various altars, and five Regular Script scribes of the Five Offices to copy imperial writings.
translations.idiomatic: Technical specialists Han Ying and Liu Xuan proposed changing Commissioner to Director, establishing the Court of Universal Mystery and Chief Clerks, appointing five Observation Masters and fifteen Ritual Attendants of the Five Offices to arrange spirit seats at the various altars, and five Regular Script scribes of the Five Offices to copy imperial writings.

sentences.zh: 有令史五人，天文觀生九十人，天文生五十人，曆生五十五人。

translations.literal: There were five Clerks, ninety astronomy observers, fifty astronomy students, and fifty-five calendar students.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had five Clerks, ninety astronomy observers, fifty astronomy students, and fifty-five calendar students.

sentences.zh: 初，有天文博士二人，正八品下；

translations.literal: Initially, there were two Astronomy Masters, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: Initially there were two Astronomy Masters, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 曆博士一人，從八品上；

translations.literal: one Calendar Master, upper sub-eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: one Calendar Master, ranked at upper sub-eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 司辰師五人，正九品下；

translations.literal: five Time Regulators, lower ninth rank;
translations.idiomatic: five Time Regulators, ranked at lower ninth grade;

sentences.zh: 裝書曆生。

translations.literal: and calendar document binders.
translations.idiomatic: and calendar document binders.

sentences.zh: 掌候天文，掌教習天文氣色，掌寫御曆，後皆省。

translations.literal: They observed the heavens, taught celestial phenomena and atmospheric colors, and copied the imperial calendar—all later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: They observed the heavens, taught celestial phenomena and atmospheric colors, and copied the imperial calendar—all of these posts were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 春官、夏官、秋官、冬官、中官正，各一人，正五品上；

translations.literal: One each of Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, and Central Office Directors, upper fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There was one each of Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, and Central Office Director, all ranked at upper fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 副正各一人，正六品上。

translations.literal: one each of Vice Directors, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one Vice Director for each office, ranked at upper sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌司四時，各司其方之變異。

translations.literal: They managed the four seasons, each overseeing anomalies in his assigned direction.
translations.idiomatic: They managed the four seasons, each overseeing celestial anomalies in his assigned direction.

sentences.zh: 冠加一星珠，以應五緯；

translations.literal: On their caps they wore a single star pearl, corresponding to the five planets;
translations.idiomatic: On their caps they wore a single star pearl, corresponding to the five planets;

sentences.zh: 衣從其方色。

translations.literal: their robes followed the color of their direction.
translations.idiomatic: and their robes followed the color of their direction.

sentences.zh: 元日、冬至、朔望朝會及大禮，各奏方事，而服以朝見。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day, the winter solstice, new and full moon court assemblies, and major ceremonies, each reported affairs of his direction and attended in ceremonial dress.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day, the winter solstice, new- and full-moon court assemblies, and major ceremonies, each reported affairs of his direction and attended court in ceremonial dress.

sentences.zh: 乾元三年，置五官正及副正。

translations.literal: In Qianyuan 3, the Five Office Directors and Vice Directors were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyuan 3 the Five Office Directors and Vice Directors were established.

sentences.zh: 五官保章正二人，從七品上；

translations.literal: Two Five-Office Calendar Rectifiers, upper sub-seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Five-Office Calendar Rectifiers, ranked at upper sub-seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 五官監候三人，正八品下；

translations.literal: three Five-Office Observation Masters, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: three Five-Office Observation Masters, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 五官司曆二人，從八品上。

translations.literal: two Five-Office Calendar Regulators, upper sub-eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Five-Office Calendar Regulators, ranked at upper sub-eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌曆法及測景分至表準。

translations.literal: They managed calendrical methods and the gnomon standards for measuring shadows at the equinoxes and solstices.
translations.idiomatic: They managed calendrical methods and the gnomon standards used to measure shadows at the equinoxes and solstices.

sentences.zh: 五官靈臺郎各一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: One each of Five-Office Spirit Terrace Directors, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Five-Office Spirit Terrace Director for each office, ranked at lower seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 掌候天文之變。

translations.literal: They observed changes in the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: They observed changes in the heavens.

sentences.zh: 五官挈壺正二人，正八品上；

translations.literal: Two Five-Office Clepsydra Masters, upper eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Five-Office Clepsydra Masters, ranked at upper eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 五官司辰八人，正九品上；

translations.literal: eight Five-Office Time Regulators, upper ninth rank;
translations.idiomatic: eight Five-Office Time Regulators, ranked at upper ninth grade;

sentences.zh: 漏刻博士六人，從九品下。

translations.literal: six Clepsydra Masters, lower sub-ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and six Clepsydra Masters, ranked at lower sub-ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌知漏刻。

translations.literal: They managed clepsydra timekeeping.
translations.idiomatic: They managed clepsydra timekeeping.

sentences.zh: 凡孔壺為漏，浮箭為刻，以考中星昏明，更以擊鼓為節，點以擊鐘為節。

translations.literal: The perforated vessel served as the clepsydra and the floating arrow marked the quarters, to verify the meridian stars and distinguish dusk from dawn; watches were marked by drumbeats and hours by bell strokes.
translations.idiomatic: The perforated vessel served as the clepsydra and the floating arrow marked the quarters, to verify the meridian stars and distinguish dusk from dawn; watches were marked by drumbeats and hours by bell strokes.

sentences.zh: 武后長安二年，置挈壺正。

translations.literal: In Chang'an 2 under Empress Wu, Clepsydra Masters were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Chang'an 2 under Empress Wu Clepsydra Masters were established.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，與靈臺郎、保章正、司曆、司辰，皆加五官之名。

translations.literal: In Qianyuan 1, Spirit Terrace Directors, Calendar Rectifiers, Calendar Regulators, and Time Regulators all received the prefix Five-Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyuan 1 Spirit Terrace Directors, Calendar Rectifiers, Calendar Regulators, and Time Regulators all received the prefix Five-Office.

sentences.zh: 有漏刻生四十人，典鐘、典鼓三百五十人。

translations.literal: There were forty clepsydra students and three hundred fifty bell and drum keepers.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had forty clepsydra students and three hundred fifty bell and drum keepers.

sentences.zh: 初，有刻漏視品、刻漏典事，掌知刻漏、檢校刻漏，後皆省。

translations.literal: Initially there were Clepsydra Rank Inspectors and Clepsydra Supervisors, managing and inspecting clepsydra timekeeping—all later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Initially there were Clepsydra Rank Inspectors and Clepsydra Supervisors who managed and inspected clepsydra timekeeping—all of these posts were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 殿中省監一人，從三品；

translations.literal: One Palace Domestic Service Director, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Domestic Service had one Director, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 少監二人，從四品上；

translations.literal: two Vice Directors, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two Vice Directors, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從五品上。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at upper fifth grade.

sentences.zh: 監掌天子服御之事。

translations.literal: The Director managed the Son of Heaven's clothing and personal accoutrements.
translations.idiomatic: The Director managed the emperor's clothing and personal accoutrements.

sentences.zh: 其屬有六局，曰尚食、尚藥、尚衣、尚乘、尚舍、尚輦。

translations.literal: Subordinate to it were six bureaus: Provisioner's, Pharmacy, Wardrobe, Imperial Mounts, Palace Maintenance, and Sedan Chair.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate to it were six bureaus: the Provisioner's Bureau, Pharmacy Bureau, Wardrobe Bureau, Imperial Mounts Bureau, Palace Maintenance Bureau, and Sedan Chair Bureau.

sentences.zh: 少監為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Directors assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Directors assisted the Director.

sentences.zh: 凡聽朝，率屬執繖扇列于左右；

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor held court, he led his subordinates holding parasols and fans, arrayed left and right;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor held court, the Director led his subordinates holding parasols and fans, arrayed to left and right;

sentences.zh: 大朝會、祭祀，則進爵；

translations.literal: at great court assemblies and sacrifices, they presented cups;
translations.idiomatic: at great court assemblies and sacrifices they presented cups;

sentences.zh: 行幸，則侍奉仗內、驂乘，百司皆納印而藏之，大事聽焉，有行從百司之印。

translations.literal: On travels, they attended within the imperial guard and rode as outriders; the hundred offices all surrendered their seals for safekeeping, major affairs awaited their judgment, and they carried the traveling seals of the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: on imperial travels they attended within the guard and rode as outriders; the hundred offices all surrendered their seals for safekeeping, major affairs awaited their judgment, and they carried the traveling seals of the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 左右仗廄，左曰奔星，右曰內駒。

translations.literal: The left and right guard stables: the left called Running Star, the right Inner Colt.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right guard stables were called Running Star and Inner Colt.

sentences.zh: 兩仗內又有六廄：一曰左飛，二曰右飛，三曰左萬，四曰右萬，五曰東南內，六日西南內。

translations.literal: Within the two guard units there were also six stables: first Left Flying, second Right Flying, third Left Myriad, fourth Right Myriad, fifth Southeast Inner, sixth Southwest Inner.
translations.idiomatic: Within the two guard units there were also six stables: Left Flying, Right Flying, Left Myriad, Right Myriad, Southeast Inner, and Southwest Inner.

sentences.zh: 園苑有官馬坊，每歲河隴羣牧進其良者以供御。

translations.literal: The parklands had official horse compounds; each year the herd offices of Hexi and Longyou sent their best horses for imperial use.
translations.idiomatic: The parklands had official horse compounds; each year the herd offices of Hexi and Longyou sent their best horses for imperial use.

sentences.zh: 六閑馬，以殿中監及尚乘主之。

translations.literal: The six reserve herds were managed by the Palace Domestic Service Director and the Imperial Mounts Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The six reserve herds were managed by the Palace Domestic Service Director and the Imperial Mounts Bureau.

sentences.zh: 武后萬歲通天元年，置仗內六閑：一曰飛龍，二曰祥麟，三曰鳳苑，四曰鵷鸞，五曰吉良，六曰六羣，亦號六廄。

translations.literal: In Wansui Tongtian 1 under Empress Wu, six guard-reserve herds were established: first Flying Dragon, second Auspicious Unicorn, third Phoenix Park, fourth Kingfisher and Phoenix, fifth Lucky Steed, sixth Six Herds—also called the Six Stables.
translations.idiomatic: In Wansui Tongtian 1 under Empress Wu six guard-reserve herds were established: Flying Dragon, Auspicious Unicorn, Phoenix Park, Kingfisher and Phoenix, Lucky Steed, and Six Herds—also called the Six Stables.

sentences.zh: 以殿中丞檢校仗內閑廄，以中官為內飛龍使。

translations.literal: Palace Domestic Service Assistant Directors inspected the guard-reserve stables, and eunuchs served as Inner Flying Dragon Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Domestic Service Assistant Directors inspected the guard-reserve stables, and eunuchs served as Inner Flying Dragon Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 聖曆中，置閑廄使，以殿中監承恩遇者為之，分領殿中、太僕之事，而專掌輿輦牛馬。

translations.literal: During the Shengli era, Reserve Stable Commissioners were established, drawn from favored Palace Domestic Service Directors, sharing oversight of Palace Domestic Service and Court of the Imperial Stud affairs while specializing in chariots, sedan chairs, cattle, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shengli era Reserve Stable Commissioners were established, drawn from favored Palace Domestic Service Directors; they shared oversight of Palace Domestic Service and Court of the Imperial Stud affairs while specializing in chariots, sedan chairs, cattle, and horses.

sentences.zh: 自是，宴游供奉，殿中監皆不豫。

translations.literal: From then on, the Palace Domestic Service Director no longer participated in banquet and excursion service.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Palace Domestic Service Director no longer participated in banquet and excursion service.

sentences.zh: 開元初，閑廄馬至萬餘匹，駱駝、巨象皆養焉。

translations.literal: Early in Kaiyuan, reserve stable horses reached more than ten thousand, and camels and great elephants were kept there as well.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan the reserve stables held more than ten thousand horses, and camels and great elephants were kept there as well.

sentences.zh: 以駝、馬隸閑廄，而尚乘局名存而已。

translations.literal: Camels and horses were placed under the reserve stables, and the Imperial Mounts Bureau existed in name only.
translations.idiomatic: Camels and horses were placed under the reserve stables, and the Imperial Mounts Bureau existed in name only.

sentences.zh: 閑廄使押五坊，以供時狩：一曰鵰坊，二曰鶻坊，三曰鷂坊，四曰鷹坊，五曰狗坊。

translations.literal: The Reserve Stable Commissioner supervised the Five Aviaries for seasonal hunting: first Eagle, second Goshawk, third Sparrow Hawk, fourth Hawk, fifth Dog.
translations.idiomatic: The Reserve Stable Commissioner supervised the Five Aviaries for seasonal hunting: Eagle, Goshawk, Sparrow Hawk, Hawk, and Dog.

sentences.zh: 侍御尚醫二人，正六品上；

translations.literal: Two Attending Imperial Physicians, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Attending Imperial Physicians, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 主事二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: two Section Chiefs, upper sub-ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Section Chiefs, ranked at upper sub-ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 武德元年，改殿內省曰殿中省。

translations.literal: In Wude 1, the Inner Palace Service was renamed the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 1 the Inner Palace Service was renamed the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，曰中御府，監曰大監，丞曰大夫。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, it was called the Central Imperial Household; the Director became Grand Director, the Assistant Director Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 it was called the Central Imperial Household; the Director became Grand Director and the Assistant Director Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 有令史四人，書令史十二人，左右仗、千牛各十人，掌固、亭長各八人。

translations.literal: There were four Clerks, twelve Recording Clerks, ten each for the left and right guard units and Thousand-Ox Guard, and eight each of watchmen and station chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The office had four Clerks, twelve Recording Clerks, ten each for the left and right guard units and Thousand-Ox Guard, and eight each of watchmen and station chiefs.

sentences.zh: 舊有天藏府，開元二十三年省。

translations.literal: Formerly there was the Heavenly Treasury, abolished in Kaiyuan 23.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there was the Heavenly Treasury, which was abolished in Kaiyuan 23.

sentences.zh: 進馬五人，正七品上。

translations.literal: Five Horse Attendants, upper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were five Horse Attendants, ranked at upper seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 掌大陳設，戎服執鞭，居立仗馬之左，視馬進退。

translations.literal: They managed major formations, wearing military dress and holding whips, standing to the left of the formation horses, watching their advance and withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: They managed major formations, wearing military dress and holding whips, standing to the left of the formation horses and watching their advance and withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 天寶八載，罷南衙立仗馬，因省進馬；

translations.literal: In Tianbao 8, the Southern Yamen formation horses were abolished, and the Horse Attendants were accordingly reduced;
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 8 the Southern Yamen formation horses were abolished, and the Horse Attendants were accordingly reduced;

sentences.zh: 十二載復置，乾元後又省，大曆十四年復。

translations.literal: in year 12 they were restored; after Qianyuan they were again reduced, and in Dali 14 restored once more.
translations.idiomatic: in year 12 they were restored; after Qianyuan they were again reduced, and in Dali 14 restored once more.

sentences.zh: 尚食局奉御二人，正五品下；

translations.literal: Two Provisioner's Bureau Palace Attendants, lower fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Provisioner's Bureau had two Palace Attendants, ranked at lower fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 直長五人，正七品上。

translations.literal: five Direct Supervisors, upper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: and five Direct Supervisors, ranked at upper seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 諸奉御、直長，品皆如之。

translations.literal: For all Palace Attendants and Direct Supervisors, the ranks were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The ranks for Palace Attendants and Direct Supervisors in the other bureaus were the same.

sentences.zh: 食醫八人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Eight Dietary Physicians, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight Dietary Physicians, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 奉御掌儲供，直長為之貳。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant managed stored provisions; the Direct Supervisor assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant managed stored provisions, and the Direct Supervisor assisted.

sentences.zh: 進御必辨時禁，先嘗之；

translations.literal: Food presented to the emperor had to observe seasonal prohibitions and was tasted first;
translations.idiomatic: Food presented to the emperor had to observe seasonal prohibitions and was tasted first;

sentences.zh: 饗百官賓客，則與光祿視品秩而供；

translations.literal: when entertaining the hundred offices and guests, they supplied food according to rank together with the Court of Imperial Entertainments;
translations.idiomatic: when entertaining the hundred offices and guests, they supplied food according to rank together with the Court of Imperial Entertainments;

sentences.zh: 凡諸陵月享，視膳乃獻。

translations.literal: for monthly offerings at the imperial tombs, they presented food after inspection.
translations.idiomatic: for monthly offerings at the imperial tombs, they presented food only after inspection.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚食局曰奉膳局，諸局奉御皆曰大夫。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Provisioner's Bureau was renamed the Food Service Bureau, and Palace Attendants in all bureaus were called Grand Masters.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Provisioner's Bureau was renamed the Food Service Bureau, and Palace Attendants in all bureaus were called Grandees.

sentences.zh: 有書令史二人，書吏五人，主食十六人，主膳八百四十人，掌固八人。

translations.literal: There were two Recording Clerks, five document clerks, sixteen staple-food stewards, eight hundred forty meal stewards, and eight watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had two Recording Clerks, five document clerks, sixteen staple-food stewards, eight hundred forty meal stewards, and eight watchmen.

sentences.zh: 尚藥局奉御二人，直長二人。

translations.literal: Two Pharmacy Bureau Palace Attendants and two Direct Supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: The Pharmacy Bureau had two Palace Attendants and two Direct Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 掌和御藥、診視。

translations.literal: They managed compounding of imperial medicines and medical examination.
translations.idiomatic: They compounded imperial medicines and conducted medical examinations.

sentences.zh: 凡藥供御，中書、門下長官及諸衞上將軍各一人，與監、奉御涖之。

translations.literal: Whenever medicine was supplied to the emperor, one senior official each from the Secretariat and Chancellery and one senior general from each guard, together with the Director and Palace Attendant, supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever medicine was supplied to the emperor, one senior official each from the Secretariat and Chancellery and one senior general from each guard, together with the Director and Palace Attendant, supervised the process.

sentences.zh: 藥成，醫佐以上先嘗，疏本方，具歲月日，涖者署奏；

translations.literal: When the medicine was finished, physicians of Assistant rank and above tasted it first; the prescription was copied out with the date, and the supervisors signed and memorialized;
translations.idiomatic: When the medicine was finished, physicians of Assistant rank and above tasted it first; the prescription was copied out with the date, and the supervisors signed and memorialized it;

sentences.zh: 餌日，奉御先嘗，殿中監次之，皇太子又次之，然後進御。

translations.literal: On the day it was taken, the Palace Attendant tasted first, then the Palace Domestic Service Director, then the crown prince, and only then was it presented to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day it was taken, the Palace Attendant tasted first, then the Palace Domestic Service Director, then the crown prince, and only then was it presented to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 太常每季閱送上藥，而還其朽腐者。

translations.literal: Each quarter the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reviewed and submitted superior medicines, returning those that were decayed.
translations.idiomatic: Each quarter the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reviewed and submitted superior medicines, returning those that were decayed.

sentences.zh: 左右羽林軍，給藥；

translations.literal: The Left and Right Feathered Forest Armies received medicines;
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Feathered Forest Armies received medicines;

sentences.zh: 飛騎、萬騎病者，頒焉。

translations.literal: sick members of the Flying Cavalry and Ten Thousand Riders were also supplied.
translations.idiomatic: sick members of the Flying Cavalry and Ten Thousand Riders were also supplied.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚藥局曰奉醫局。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Pharmacy Bureau was renamed the Medical Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Pharmacy Bureau was renamed the Medical Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 有按摩師四人，呪禁師四人，書令史二人，書吏四人，直官十人，主藥十二人，藥童三十人，合口脂匠二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were four massage therapists, four incantation therapists, two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, ten direct officials, twelve medicine stewards, thirty medicine apprentices, two lip-balm craftsmen, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had four massage therapists, four incantation therapists, two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, ten direct officials, twelve medicine stewards, thirty medicine apprentices, two lip-balm craftsmen, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 侍御醫四人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Four Attending Physicians, upper sub-sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Attending Physicians, ranked at upper sub-sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌供奉診候。

translations.literal: They managed attendance and medical examination.
translations.idiomatic: They attended the emperor and conducted medical examinations.

sentences.zh: 司醫五人，正八品下；

translations.literal: Five Court Physicians, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were five Court Physicians, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 醫佐十人，正九品下。

translations.literal: ten Physician Assistants, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and ten Physician Assistants, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌分療眾疾。

translations.literal: They managed treatment of various illnesses by division of labor.
translations.idiomatic: They treated various illnesses by division of labor.

sentences.zh: 皆貞觀中置。

translations.literal: All were established during the Zhenguan era.
translations.idiomatic: All were established during the Zhenguan era.

sentences.zh: 尚衣局奉御二人，直長四人，掌供冕服、几案。

translations.literal: Two Wardrobe Bureau Palace Attendants and four Direct Supervisors managed supply of ceremonial robes and tables.
translations.idiomatic: The Wardrobe Bureau had two Palace Attendants and four Direct Supervisors, who supplied ceremonial robes and tables.

sentences.zh: 祭祀，則奉鎮圭於監，而進于天子；

translations.literal: At sacrifices, they presented the territorial tablet to the Director, who then presented it to the Son of Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices they presented the territorial tablet to the Director, who then presented it to the emperor;

sentences.zh: 大朝會，設案。

translations.literal: at great court assemblies, they set out tables.
translations.idiomatic: at great court assemblies they set out tables.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚衣局曰奉冕局。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Wardrobe Bureau was renamed the Ceremonial Robe Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Wardrobe Bureau was renamed the Ceremonial Robe Bureau.

sentences.zh: 有書令史三人，書吏四人，主衣十六人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were three Recording Clerks, four document clerks, sixteen robe stewards, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had three Recording Clerks, four document clerks, sixteen robe stewards, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 尚舍局奉御二人，直長六人，掌殿庭祭祀張設、湯沐、燈燭、汛掃。

translations.literal: Two Palace Maintenance Bureau Palace Attendants and six Direct Supervisors managed arrangement of the hall and court for sacrifices, bathing supplies, lamps and candles, and sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Maintenance Bureau had two Palace Attendants and six Direct Supervisors, who managed arrangement of the hall and court for sacrifices, bathing supplies, lamps and candles, and sweeping.

sentences.zh: 行幸，則設三部帳幕，有古帳、大帳、次帳、小次帳、小帳凡五等，各三部；

translations.literal: On travels, they set up three sets of tents in five grades: ancient tent, large tent, secondary tent, small secondary tent, and small tent—three of each;
translations.idiomatic: On imperial travels they set up three sets of tents in five grades—ancient tent, large tent, secondary tent, small secondary tent, and small tent—three of each;

sentences.zh: 其外，則蔽以排城。

translations.literal: outside these, they were screened by a palisade enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: outside these they were screened by a palisade enclosure.

sentences.zh: 大朝會，設黼扆，施躡席，薰鑪。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies, they set out the embroidered screen, spread the tiger-skin mat, and placed incense burners.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they set out the embroidered screen, spread the tiger-skin mat, and placed incense burners.

sentences.zh: 朔望，設幄而已。

translations.literal: At new and full moon, they set up canopies only.
translations.idiomatic: At new and full moon they set up canopies only.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚舍局曰奉扆局。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Palace Maintenance Bureau was renamed the Screen Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Palace Maintenance Bureau was renamed the Screen Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 有書令史三人，書吏七人，掌固十人，幕士八十人。

translations.literal: There were three Recording Clerks, seven document clerks, ten watchmen, and eighty tent stewards.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had three Recording Clerks, seven document clerks, ten watchmen, and eighty tent stewards.

sentences.zh: 舊有給使百二十人，掌供御湯沐、燈燭、雜使，貞觀中省。

translations.literal: Formerly there were one hundred twenty supply attendants, managing imperial bathing supplies, lamps and candles, and miscellaneous service—abolished during the Zhenguan era.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there were one hundred twenty supply attendants who managed imperial bathing supplies, lamps and candles, and miscellaneous service; they were abolished during the Zhenguan era.

sentences.zh: 尚乘局奉御二人，直長十人，掌內外閑廄之馬。

translations.literal: Two Imperial Mounts Bureau Palace Attendants and ten Direct Supervisors managed horses of the inner and outer reserve stables.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Mounts Bureau had two Palace Attendants and ten Direct Supervisors, who managed horses of the inner and outer reserve stables.

sentences.zh: 左右六閑：一曰飛黃，二曰吉良，三曰龍媒，四曰騊駼，五曰駃騠，六曰天苑。

translations.literal: The left and right six reserve herds: first Flying Yellow, second Lucky Steed, third Dragon Matchmaker, fourth Táo-tú, fifth Jiāo-tí, sixth Heavenly Park.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right six reserve herds were Flying Yellow, Lucky Steed, Dragon Matchmaker, Táo-tú, Jiāo-tí, and Heavenly Park.

sentences.zh: 凡外牧歲進良馬，印以三花、「飛」「鳳」之字。

translations.literal: Each year the outer herd offices sent fine horses, branded with three flowers and the characters Flying and Phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the outer herd offices sent fine horses, branded with three flowers and the characters "Flying" and "Phoenix."

sentences.zh: 飛龍廄日以八馬列宮門之外，號南衙立仗馬，仗下，乃退。

translations.literal: Daily the Flying Dragon Stable arrayed eight horses outside the palace gate, called the Southern Yamen formation horses; when the guard session ended, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Daily the Flying Dragon Stable arrayed eight horses outside the palace gate as the Southern Yamen formation horses; when the guard session ended, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 大陳設，則居樂縣之北，與象相次。

translations.literal: At major formations, they stood north of the musical ensemble, in sequence with the elephants.
translations.idiomatic: At major formations they stood north of the musical ensemble, in sequence with the elephants.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚乘局曰奉駕局。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Imperial Mounts Bureau was renamed the Chariot Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Imperial Mounts Bureau was renamed the Chariot Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 有書令史六人，書吏十四人，直官二十人，習馭五百人，掌閑五千人，典事五人，獸醫七十人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were six Recording Clerks, fourteen document clerks, twenty direct officials, five hundred horse trainers, five thousand herd keepers, five storekeepers, seventy veterinarians, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had six Recording Clerks, fourteen document clerks, twenty direct officials, five hundred horse trainers, five thousand herd keepers, five storekeepers, seventy veterinarians, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 習馭，掌調六閑之馬；

translations.literal: Horse trainers managed training horses of the six reserve herds;
translations.idiomatic: The horse trainers trained horses of the six reserve herds;

sentences.zh: 掌閑，掌飼六閑之馬，治其乘具鞍轡；

translations.literal: herd keepers fed horses of the six reserve herds and maintained saddles and bridles;
translations.idiomatic: the herd keepers fed horses of the six reserve herds and maintained saddles and bridles;

sentences.zh: 典事，掌六閑芻粟。

translations.literal: storekeepers managed fodder and grain for the six reserve herds.
translations.idiomatic: the storekeepers managed fodder and grain for the six reserve herds.

sentences.zh: 太宗置司廩，司庫；

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong established the Granary Office and Storehouse Office;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong established the Granary Office and Storehouse Office;

sentences.zh: 高宗置習馭、獸醫。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong established horse trainers and veterinarians.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong established the horse trainers and veterinarians.

sentences.zh: 司廩、司庫各一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One each of Granary Director and Storehouse Director, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Granary Director and one Storehouse Director, each ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌六閑藳秸出納。

translations.literal: They managed receipt and issue of straw and stalks for the six reserve herds.
translations.idiomatic: They managed receipt and issue of straw and stalks for the six reserve herds.

sentences.zh: 奉乘十八人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Eighteen Chariot Attendants, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighteen Chariot Attendants, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌飼習御馬。

translations.literal: They managed feeding and training of imperial horses.
translations.idiomatic: They fed and trained imperial horses.

sentences.zh: 尚輦局奉御二人；

translations.literal: Two Sedan Chair Bureau Palace Attendants;
translations.idiomatic: The Sedan Chair Bureau had two Palace Attendants;

sentences.zh: 直長三人；

translations.literal: three Direct Supervisors;
translations.idiomatic: three Direct Supervisors;

sentences.zh: 尚輦二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: two Sedan Chair Masters, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Sedan Chair Masters, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌輿輦、繖扇，大朝會則陳于庭，大祭祀則陳于廟，皆繖二、翰一、扇一百五十有六，既事而藏之。

translations.literal: They managed sedan chairs, parasols, and fans; at great court assemblies they were displayed in the courtyard, at great sacrifices in the temple—all two parasols, one writing kit, and one hundred fifty-six fans, stored away once the rite was done.
translations.idiomatic: They managed sedan chairs, parasols, and fans; at great court assemblies these were displayed in the courtyard, and at great sacrifices in the temple—two parasols, one writing kit, and one hundred fifty-six fans in all, stored away once the rite was finished.

sentences.zh: 常朝則去扇，左右留者三。

translations.literal: At regular court, the fans were removed and three were kept on left and right.
translations.idiomatic: At regular court the fans were removed, and three were kept on the left and right.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改尚輦局曰奉輿局。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the Sedan Chair Bureau was renamed the Sedan Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the Sedan Chair Bureau was renamed the Sedan Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 有書令史二人，書吏四人，七輦主輦各六人，掌扇六十人，掌翰三十人，掌輦四十二人，奉輿十五人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: There were two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, six sedan masters for each of the seven sedan chairs, sixty fan keepers, thirty writing-kit keepers, forty-two sedan keepers, fifteen sedan attendants, and six watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, six sedan masters for each of the seven sedan chairs, sixty fan keepers, thirty writing-kit keepers, forty-two sedan keepers, fifteen sedan attendants, and six watchmen.

sentences.zh: 掌扇、掌翰，掌執繖扇、紙筆硯雜供奉之事；

translations.literal: Fan keepers and writing-kit keepers managed holding parasols and fans, paper, brush, inkstone, and miscellaneous attendance;
translations.idiomatic: The fan keepers and writing-kit keepers held parasols and fans and managed paper, brush, inkstone, and miscellaneous attendance;

sentences.zh: 掌輦，掌率主輦以供其事。

translations.literal: sedan keepers led the sedan masters to supply what was needed.
translations.idiomatic: the sedan keepers led the sedan masters to supply what was needed.

sentences.zh: 高宗置掌翰。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong established the writing-kit keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong established the writing-kit keepers.

sentences.zh: 內侍省監二人，從三品；

translations.literal: Two Palace Eunuch Service Directors, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Eunuch Service had two Directors, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 少監二人，內侍四人，皆從四品上。

translations.literal: two Vice Directors and four Palace Eunuchs, all upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: two Vice Directors and four Palace Eunuchs, all ranked at upper fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 監掌內侍奉，宣制令。

translations.literal: The Directors managed inner palace attendance and proclaimed edicts and orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Directors managed inner palace attendance and proclaimed edicts and orders.

sentences.zh: 其屬六局，曰掖庭、宮闈、奚官、內僕、內府、內坊。

translations.literal: Subordinate to it were six bureaus: Palace Women, Inner Gates, Attendants, Inner Servants, Inner Treasury, and Inner Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate to it were six bureaus: the Palace Women Bureau, Inner Gates Bureau, Attendants Bureau, Inner Servants Bureau, Inner Treasury Bureau, and Inner Workshops Bureau.

sentences.zh: 少監、內侍為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Directors and Palace Eunuchs assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Directors and Palace Eunuchs assisted the Directors.

sentences.zh: 皇后親蠶，則升壇執儀；

translations.literal: When the empress personally tended silkworms, they ascended the altar and performed the rites;
translations.idiomatic: when the empress personally tended silkworms, they ascended the altar and performed the rites;

sentences.zh: 大駕出入，為夾引。

translations.literal: when the great imperial procession entered or left, they served as flank escorts.
translations.idiomatic: when the great imperial procession entered or left, they served as flank escorts.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，改長秋監曰內侍監，內承奉曰內常侍，內承直曰內給事。

translations.literal: In Wude 4, the Director of the Long Autumn was renamed Palace Eunuch Director, Inner Attendant renamed Palace Eunuch Regular Attendant, and Inner Direct Attendant renamed Inner Supply Master.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 the Director of the Long Autumn was renamed Palace Eunuch Director, the Inner Attendant became the Palace Eunuch Regular Attendant, and the Inner Direct Attendant became the Inner Supply Master.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，改監為省。

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, the office was renamed a service.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 the office was renamed a service.

sentences.zh: 武后垂拱元年，曰司宮臺。

translations.literal: In Chuigong 1 under Empress Wu, it was called the Palace Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Chuigong 1 under Empress Wu it was called the Palace Office.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載，置內侍監，改內侍曰少監；

translations.literal: In Tianbao 13, the Palace Eunuch Director was established and Palace Eunuchs renamed Vice Directors;
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 13 the Palace Eunuch Director was established and Palace Eunuchs were renamed Vice Directors;

sentences.zh: 尋更置內侍。

translations.literal: soon Palace Eunuchs were established again.
translations.idiomatic: soon the post of Palace Eunuch was established again.

sentences.zh: 有高品一千六百九十六人，品官白身二千九百三十二人，令史八人，書令史十六人。

translations.literal: There were one thousand six hundred ninety-six ranked eunuchs, two thousand nine hundred thirty-two ranked officials without office, eight Clerks, and sixteen Recording Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The service had one thousand six hundred ninety-six ranked eunuchs, two thousand nine hundred thirty-two ranked officials without office, eight Clerks, and sixteen Recording Clerks.

sentences.zh: 內常侍六人，正五品下，通判省事。

translations.literal: Six Palace Eunuch Regular Attendants, lower fifth rank, jointly adjudicating service affairs.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Palace Eunuch Regular Attendants, ranked at lower fifth grade, who jointly adjudicated service affairs.

sentences.zh: 內給事十人，從五品下。

translations.literal: Ten Inner Supply Masters, lower sub-fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten Inner Supply Masters, ranked at lower sub-fifth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌承旨勞問，分判省事。

translations.literal: They received orders and conveyed inquiries, and divided adjudication of service affairs.
translations.idiomatic: They received imperial orders and conveyed inquiries, and divided adjudication of service affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡元日、冬至，百官賀皇后，則出入宣傳；

translations.literal: On New Year's Day and the winter solstice, when the hundred offices congratulated the empress, they entered and left to announce and transmit;
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day and the winter solstice, when the hundred offices congratulated the empress, they entered and left to announce and transmit messages;

sentences.zh: 宮人衣服費用，則具品秩，計其多少，春秋宣送于中書。

translations.literal: for palace women's clothing expenses, they listed ranks, calculated the amounts, and in spring and autumn reported them to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: for palace women's clothing expenses they listed ranks, calculated the amounts, and in spring and autumn reported them to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 主事二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Section Chiefs, lower sub-ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Section Chiefs, ranked at lower sub-ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 內謁者監十人，正六品下。

translations.literal: Ten Inner Reception Supervisors, lower sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten Inner Reception Supervisors, ranked at lower sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌儀法、宣奏、承敕令及外命婦名帳。

translations.literal: They managed ceremonial protocol, announcements and memorials, receipt of edicts and orders, and registers of titled women outside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: They managed ceremonial protocol, announcements and memorials, receipt of edicts and orders, and registers of titled women outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 凡諸親命婦朝會者，籍其數上內侍省；

translations.literal: For all consorts and titled women attending court assemblies, their numbers were registered and reported to the Palace Eunuch Service;
translations.idiomatic: For all consorts and titled women attending court assemblies, their numbers were registered and reported to the Palace Eunuch Service;

sentences.zh: 命婦下車，則導至朝堂奏聞。

translations.literal: when a titled woman dismounted from her carriage, they guided her to the court hall and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: when a titled woman dismounted from her carriage, they guided her to the court hall and reported her arrival.

sentences.zh: 唐廢內謁者局，置內典引十八人，掌諸親命婦朝參，出入導引。

translations.literal: The Tang abolished the Inner Reception Bureau and established eighteen Inner Protocol Guides, managing court attendance of consorts and titled women and guiding their entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang abolished the Inner Reception Bureau and established eighteen Inner Protocol Guides to manage court attendance of consorts and titled women and guide their entry and exit.

sentences.zh: 有內亭長六人，掌固八人。

translations.literal: There were six inner station chiefs and eight watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The office had six inner station chiefs and eight watchmen.

sentences.zh: 內謁者十二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Twelve Inner Reception Attendants, lower sub-eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were twelve Inner Reception Attendants, ranked at lower sub-eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌諸親命婦朝集班位，分涖諸門。

translations.literal: They managed assembly positions of consorts and titled women at court and supervised the various gates.
translations.idiomatic: They managed assembly positions of consorts and titled women at court and supervised the various gates.

sentences.zh: 內寺伯六人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Six Inner Palace Rectors, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Inner Palace Rectors, ranked at lower seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 掌糾察宮內不法，歲儺則涖出入。

translations.literal: They investigated unlawful conduct within the palace; at the year-end exorcism they supervised entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: They investigated unlawful conduct within the palace; at the year-end exorcism they supervised entry and exit.

sentences.zh: 寺人六人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Six Palace Attendants, lower sub-seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Palace Attendants, ranked at lower sub-seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 掌皇后出入執御刀宂從。

translations.literal: They managed the empress's entry and exit, bearing imperial swords as escorts.
translations.idiomatic: They attended the empress's entry and exit, bearing imperial swords as escorts.

sentences.zh: 掖庭局令二人，從七品下；

translations.literal: Two Palace Women Bureau Commissioners, lower sub-seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Women Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower sub-seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 丞三人，從八品下。

translations.literal: three Assistant Directors, lower sub-eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and three Assistant Directors, ranked at lower sub-eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌宮人簿帳、女工。

translations.literal: They managed palace women's registers and female craftwork.
translations.idiomatic: They managed palace women's registers and female craftwork.

sentences.zh: 凡宮人名籍，司其除附；

translations.literal: For all palace women's name registers, they managed appointments and attachments;
translations.idiomatic: They managed appointments and attachments on all palace women's name registers;

sentences.zh: 公桑養蠶，會其課業；

translations.literal: for public mulberry fields and silkworm raising, they convened and assessed production quotas;
translations.idiomatic: for public mulberry fields and silkworm raising they convened and assessed production quotas;

sentences.zh: 供奉物皆取焉。

translations.literal: all tribute items were drawn from them.
translations.idiomatic: all tribute items were drawn from them.

sentences.zh: 婦人以罪配沒，工縫巧者隸之，無技能者隸司農。

translations.literal: Women sentenced and confiscated for crimes: skilled seamstresses were attached to the bureau, those without skills to the Court of the National Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Women sentenced and confiscated for crimes were assigned accordingly: skilled seamstresses to the bureau, those without skills to the Court of the National Granaries.

sentences.zh: 諸司營作須女功者，取於戶婢。

translations.literal: When various offices needed female labor for construction, they drew on household bondwomen.
translations.idiomatic: When various offices needed female labor for construction, they drew on household bondwomen.

sentences.zh: 有書令史四人，書吏八人，計史二人，典事十人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were four Recording Clerks, eight document clerks, two accounting clerks, ten storekeepers, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had four Recording Clerks, eight document clerks, two accounting clerks, ten storekeepers, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 計史掌料功程。

translations.literal: Accounting clerks managed calculation of work quotas.
translations.idiomatic: The accounting clerks calculated work quotas.

sentences.zh: 宮教博士二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Palace Instruction Masters, lower sub-ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Palace Instruction Masters, ranked at lower sub-ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌教習宮人書、算、眾藝。

translations.literal: They managed instruction of palace women in writing, calculation, and various arts.
translations.idiomatic: They instructed palace women in writing, calculation, and various arts.

sentences.zh: 初，內文學館隸中書省，以儒學者一人為學士，掌教宮人。

translations.literal: Initially the Inner Literary Institute was subordinate to the Secretariat; one Confucian scholar served as Academician and managed instruction of palace women.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Inner Literary Institute was subordinate to the Secretariat; one Confucian scholar served as Academician and instructed palace women.

sentences.zh: 武后如意元年，改曰習藝館，又改曰萬林內教坊，尋復舊。

translations.literal: In Ruyi 1 under Empress Wu, it was renamed the Arts Training Institute, then the Myriad Forest Inner Teaching Office, and soon restored to the former name.
translations.idiomatic: In Ruyi 1 under Empress Wu it was renamed the Arts Training Institute, then the Myriad Forest Inner Teaching Office, and soon restored to the former name.

sentences.zh: 有內教博士十八人，經學五人，史、子、集綴文三人，楷書二人，莊老、太一、篆書、律令、吟詠、飛白書、算、碁各一人。

translations.literal: There were eighteen Inner Instruction Masters: five in classical learning, three in history, masters, and collected prose, two in Regular Script, and one each in Zhuangzi and Laozi, Grand Unity, seal script, law codes, lyric recitation, flying-white calligraphy, calculation, and go.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighteen Inner Instruction Masters: five in classical learning, three in history, masters, and collected prose, two in Regular Script, and one each in Zhuangzi and Laozi, Grand Unity, seal script, law codes, lyric recitation, flying-white calligraphy, calculation, and go.

sentences.zh: 開元末，館廢，以內教博士以下隸內侍省，中官為之。

translations.literal: At the end of Kaiyuan the institute was abolished; Inner Instruction Masters and below were placed under the Palace Eunuch Service and held by eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Kaiyuan the institute was abolished; Inner Instruction Masters and below were placed under the Palace Eunuch Service and held by eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 監作四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Four Construction Supervisors, lower sub-ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Construction Supervisors, ranked at lower sub-ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌監涖雜作，典工役。

translations.literal: They supervised miscellaneous construction and managed laborers.
translations.idiomatic: They supervised miscellaneous construction and managed laborers.

sentences.zh: 宮闈局令二人，從七品下；

translations.literal: Two Inner Gates Bureau Commissioners, lower sub-seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Gates Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower sub-seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, lower sub-eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at lower sub-eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌侍宮闈，出入管籥。

translations.literal: They attended the inner gates, managing keys for entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: They attended the inner gates and managed keys for entry and exit.

sentences.zh: 凡享太廟，皇后神主出入，則帥其屬輿之。

translations.literal: Whenever offerings were made at the Grand Temple and the empress's spirit tablet entered or left, they led their subordinates to carry it in a sedan.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever offerings were made at the Grand Temple and the empress's spirit tablet entered or left, they led their subordinates to carry it in a sedan.

sentences.zh: 總小給使學生之籍，給以糧稟。

translations.literal: They maintained registers of junior supply attendants and students, issuing grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: They maintained registers of junior supply attendants and students and issued grain rations.

sentences.zh: 有書令史三人，書吏六人，內閽史二十人，內掌扇十六人，內給使無常員，小給使學生五十人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: There were three Recording Clerks, six document clerks, twenty inner gate clerks, sixteen inner fan keepers, inner supply attendants without fixed numbers, fifty junior supply attendants and students, and four watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had three Recording Clerks, six document clerks, twenty inner gate clerks, sixteen inner fan keepers, inner supply attendants without fixed numbers, fifty junior supply attendants and students, and four watchmen.

sentences.zh: 凡無官品者，號曰內給使，掌諸門進物之曆；

translations.literal: All those without official rank were called inner supply attendants and managed schedules of items brought in through the gates;
translations.idiomatic: All those without official rank were called inner supply attendants and managed schedules of items brought in through the gates;

sentences.zh: 內閽史，掌承傳諸門，出納管鑰；

translations.literal: inner gate clerks transmitted messages at the gates and dispensed keys;
translations.idiomatic: the inner gate clerks transmitted messages at the gates and dispensed keys;

sentences.zh: 內掌扇，掌中宮繖扇。

translations.literal: inner fan keepers managed parasols and fans of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: the inner fan keepers managed parasols and fans of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 奚官局令二人，正八品下；

translations.literal: Two Attendants Bureau Commissioners, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Attendants Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌奚隸、工役、宮官之品。

translations.literal: They managed attendants, laborers, and ranks of palace officials.
translations.idiomatic: They managed attendants, laborers, and the ranks of palace officials.

sentences.zh: 宮人病，則供醫藥；

translations.literal: When palace women fell ill, they supplied medicines;
translations.idiomatic: When palace women fell ill, they supplied medicines;

sentences.zh: 死，給衣服，各視其品。

translations.literal: when they died, clothing was provided according to each woman's rank.
translations.idiomatic: when they died, clothing was provided according to each woman's rank.

sentences.zh: 陪陵而葬者，將作給匠戶，衞士營冢，三品葬給百人，四品八十人，五品六十人，六品、七品十人，八品、九品七人；

translations.literal: Those buried beside the imperial tombs: the Directorate of Imperial Construction supplied craftsmen, guards built the mound—third rank one hundred men for burial, fourth rank eighty, fifth rank sixty, sixth and seventh ranks ten, eighth and ninth ranks seven;
translations.idiomatic: Those buried beside the imperial tombs received craftsmen from the Directorate of Imperial Construction and guards to build the mound—one hundred men for third rank, eighty for fourth, sixty for fifth, ten for sixth and seventh ranks, and seven for eighth and ninth ranks;

sentences.zh: 無品者，斂以松棺五釘，葬以犢車，給三人。

translations.literal: those without rank were encoffined in pine with five nails, buried by ox-cart, and given three attendants.
translations.idiomatic: those without rank were encoffined in pine with five nails, buried by ox-cart, and given three attendants.

sentences.zh: 皆監門校尉、直長涖之。

translations.literal: All were supervised by Gate Guard captains and direct supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: All were supervised by Gate Guard captains and direct supervisors.

sentences.zh: 內命婦五品以上無親戚者，以近冢同姓中男一人主祭于墓；

translations.literal: Inner titled women of fifth rank and above without relatives were assigned one middle-aged man of the same surname from a nearby tomb to preside at sacrifices at the grave;
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled women of fifth rank and above without relatives were assigned one middle-aged man of the same surname from a nearby tomb to preside at sacrifices at the grave;

sentences.zh: 無同姓者，春、秋祠以少牢。

translations.literal: if there was no man of the same surname, spring and autumn sacrifices used a lesser victim.
translations.idiomatic: if there was no man of the same surname, spring and autumn sacrifices used a lesser victim.

sentences.zh: 有書令史三人，書吏六人，典事、藥童、掌固各四人。

translations.literal: There were three Recording Clerks, six document clerks, and four each of storekeepers, medicine apprentices, and watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had three Recording Clerks, six document clerks, and four each of storekeepers, medicine apprentices, and watchmen.

sentences.zh: 內僕局令二人，正八品下；

translations.literal: Two Inner Servants Bureau Commissioners, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Servants Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌中宮車乘。

translations.literal: They managed vehicles of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: They managed vehicles of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 皇后出，則令居左、丞居右，夾引。

translations.literal: When the empress went out, the Commissioner stood on the left and the Assistant Director on the right, escorting on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress went out, the Commissioner stood on the left and the Assistant Director on the right, escorting on both sides.

sentences.zh: 有書令史二人，書吏四人，駕士百四十人，典事八人，掌固八人。

translations.literal: There were two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, one hundred forty charioteers, eight storekeepers, and eight watchmen.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had two Recording Clerks, four document clerks, one hundred forty charioteers, eight storekeepers, and eight watchmen.

sentences.zh: 駕士掌習御車輿、雜畜。

translations.literal: Charioteers managed training of imperial carriages and miscellaneous livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The charioteers trained imperial carriages and managed miscellaneous livestock.

sentences.zh: 內府局令二人，正八品下；

translations.literal: Two Inner Treasury Bureau Commissioners, lower eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Treasury Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌中藏寶貨給納之數，及供燈燭、湯沐、張設。

translations.literal: They managed quantities of treasures stored in the inner treasury for receipt and issue, and supplied lamps and candles, bathing supplies, and furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: They managed quantities of treasures stored in the inner treasury for receipt and issue, and supplied lamps and candles, bathing supplies, and furnishings.

sentences.zh: 凡朝會，五品已上及有功將士、蕃酋辭還，皆賜於庭。

translations.literal: At all court assemblies, officials of fifth rank and above, meritorious soldiers and officers, and tribal chiefs taking leave to return home were all granted gifts in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: At all court assemblies, officials of fifth rank and above, meritorious soldiers and officers, and tribal chiefs taking leave to return home were all granted gifts in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 有書令史二人，書吏、典史、掌固各四人，典事六人。

translations.literal: There were two Recording Clerks, four each of document clerks, archive clerks, and watchmen, and six storekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had two Recording Clerks, four each of document clerks, archive clerks, and watchmen, and six storekeepers.

sentences.zh: 太子內坊局令二人，從五品下；

translations.literal: Two Crown Prince Inner Workshops Bureau Commissioners, lower sub-fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince Inner Workshops Bureau had two Commissioners, ranked at lower sub-fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: two Assistant Directors, lower sub-seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: and two Assistant Directors, ranked at lower sub-seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 掌東宮閤內及宮人糧稟。

translations.literal: They managed the inner quarters of the Eastern Palace and grain rations for palace women.
translations.idiomatic: They managed the inner quarters of the Eastern Palace and grain rations for palace women.

sentences.zh: 坊事五人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Five Workshop Supervisors, lower sub-eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were five Workshop Supervisors, ranked at lower sub-eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 初，內坊隸東宮。

translations.literal: Initially the Inner Workshops were subordinate to the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Inner Workshops were subordinate to the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 開元二十七年，隸內侍省，為局，改典內曰令，置丞。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan 27 they were placed under the Palace Eunuch Service as a bureau; the Inner Director was renamed Commissioner and Assistant Directors were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 27 they were placed under the Palace Eunuch Service as a bureau; the Inner Director was renamed Commissioner and Assistant Directors were established.

sentences.zh: 坊事及導客舍人六人，掌序導賓客；

translations.literal: Workshop Supervisors and six Guest Guide Attendants managed ordering and guiding guests;
translations.idiomatic: The Workshop Supervisors and six Guest Guide Attendants ordered and guided guests;

sentences.zh: 閤帥六人，掌帥閽人、內給使以供其事；

translations.literal: six Gate Captains led gatekeepers and inner supply attendants to supply what was needed;
translations.idiomatic: six Gate Captains led gatekeepers and inner supply attendants to supply what was needed;

sentences.zh: 內閽人八人，掌承諸門出入管鑰，內繖扇、燈燭；

translations.literal: eight inner gatekeepers managed keys for entry and exit at the gates, and inner parasols, fans, lamps, and candles;
translations.idiomatic: eight inner gatekeepers managed keys for entry and exit at the gates, along with inner parasols, fans, lamps, and candles;

sentences.zh: 內廄尉二人，掌車乘。

translations.literal: two inner stable captains managed vehicles.
translations.idiomatic: two inner stable captains managed vehicles.

sentences.zh: 有錄事一人，令史三人，書令史五人，典事二人，駕士三十人，亭長、掌固各一人。

translations.literal: There was one recorder, three Clerks, five Recording Clerks, two storekeepers, thirty charioteers, and one each of station chief and watchman.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had one recorder, three Clerks, five Recording Clerks, two storekeepers, thirty charioteers, and one station chief and one watchman.

sentences.zh: 典直四人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Four Protocol Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Protocol Directors, ranked at lower ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內儀式導引，通傳勞問，糾劾非違，察出納。

translations.literal: They managed guidance in inner palace ceremonial, transmitted inquiries and condolences, investigated violations, and inspected receipt and issue.
translations.idiomatic: They guided inner palace ceremonial, transmitted inquiries and condolences, investigated violations, and inspected receipt and issue.

sentences.zh: 內官貴妃、惠妃、麗妃、華妃，各一人，正一品。

translations.literal: Inner consorts: one each of Noble Consort, Graceful Consort, Beautiful Consort, and Splendid Consort, upper first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The inner consorts were one each of Noble Consort, Graceful Consort, Beautiful Consort, and Splendid Consort, all ranked at upper first grade.

sentences.zh: 掌佐皇后論婦禮於內，無所不統。

translations.literal: They assisted the empress in discussing women's rites within the palace and oversaw all matters.
translations.idiomatic: They assisted the empress in discussing women's rites within the palace and oversaw all inner affairs.

sentences.zh: 唐因隋制，有貴妃、淑妃、德妃、賢妃，各一人，為夫人，正一品；

translations.literal: Following Sui institutions, the Tang had one each of Noble Consort, Pure Consort, Virtuous Consort, and Worthy Consort, called Ladies, upper first rank;
translations.idiomatic: Following Sui institutions, the Tang had one each of Noble Consort, Pure Consort, Virtuous Consort, and Worthy Consort, called Ladies, ranked at upper first grade;

sentences.zh: 昭儀、昭容、昭媛、脩儀、脩容、脩媛、充儀、充容、充媛，各一人，為九嬪，正二品；

translations.literal: one each of Bright Lady, Bright Beauty, Bright Companion, Cultivated Lady, Cultivated Beauty, Cultivated Companion, Fulfilling Lady, Fulfilling Beauty, and Fulfilling Companion, called the Nine Consorts, upper second rank;
translations.idiomatic: one each of Bright Lady, Bright Beauty, Bright Companion, Cultivated Lady, Cultivated Beauty, Cultivated Companion, Fulfilling Lady, Fulfilling Beauty, and Fulfilling Companion, called the Nine Consorts, ranked at upper second grade;

sentences.zh: 婕妤九人，正三品；

translations.literal: nine Fair Ladies, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: nine Fair Ladies, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 美人四人，正四品；

translations.literal: four Beauties, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: four Beauties, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 才人五人，正五品；

translations.literal: five Talented Ladies, upper fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: five Talented Ladies, ranked at upper fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 寶林二十七人，正六品；

translations.literal: twenty-seven Treasure Grove Ladies, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-seven Treasure Grove Ladies, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 御女二十七人，正七品；

translations.literal: twenty-seven Palace Women, upper seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-seven Palace Women, ranked at upper seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 采女二十七人，正八品。

translations.literal: twenty-seven Selected Women, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and twenty-seven Selected Women, ranked at upper eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 六尚亦曰諸尚書，正三品；

translations.literal: The Six Chiefs were also called Chief Ladies, upper third rank;
translations.idiomatic: The Six Chiefs were also called Chief Ladies, ranked at upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四司亦曰諸司事，正四品；

translations.literal: the twenty-four Directors were also called Bureau Supervisors, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Directors were also called Bureau Supervisors, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四典亦曰諸典事，正六品；

translations.literal: the twenty-four Custodians were also called Custodian Supervisors, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Custodians were also called Custodian Supervisors, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四掌亦曰諸掌事。

translations.literal: the twenty-four Handlers were also called Handler Supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: and the twenty-four Handlers were also called Handler Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，置贊德二人，正一品；

translations.literal: In Longshuo 2, two Virtue Praisers were established, upper first rank;
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2 two Virtue Praisers were established, ranked at upper first grade;

sentences.zh: 宣儀四人，正二品；

translations.literal: four Ceremonial Ladies, upper second rank;
translations.idiomatic: four Ceremonial Ladies, ranked at upper second grade;

sentences.zh: 承閨五人，正四品；

translations.literal: five Inner Attendants, upper fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: five Inner Attendants, ranked at upper fourth grade;

sentences.zh: 承旨五人，正五品；

translations.literal: five Order Receivers, upper fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: five Order Receivers, ranked at upper fifth grade;

sentences.zh: 衞仙六人，正六品；

translations.literal: six Guarding Immortals, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: six Guarding Immortals, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 供奉八人，正七品；

translations.literal: eight Attendants, upper seventh rank;
