translations.idiomatic: eight Attendants, ranked at upper seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 侍櫛二十人，正八品；

translations.literal: twenty Comb Attendants, upper eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: twenty Comb Attendants, ranked at upper eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 侍巾三十人，正九品。

translations.literal: thirty Towel Attendants, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and thirty Towel Attendants, ranked at upper ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 咸亨復舊。

translations.literal: In Xianheng the former system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianheng the former system was restored.

sentences.zh: 開元中，玄宗以后妃四星，一為后，有后而復置四妃，非典法，乃置惠妃、麗妃、華妃，以代三夫人；

translations.literal: During Kaiyuan, since Emperor Xuanzong took the four stars of consorts as one empress, and having an empress while restoring four consorts was not canonical law, he established Graceful Consort, Beautiful Consort, and Splendid Consort to replace the three Ladies;
translations.idiomatic: During Kaiyuan, since Emperor Xuanzong took the four consort stars as one empress, and having an empress while restoring four consorts was not canonical law, he established Graceful Consort, Beautiful Consort, and Splendid Consort to replace the three Ladies;

sentences.zh: 又置六儀、美人、才人，增尚宮、尚儀、尚服三局。

translations.literal: he also established the Six Consorts, Beauties, and Talented Ladies, and added the Inner Palace, Rites, and Wardrobe bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: he also established the Six Consorts, Beauties, and Talented Ladies, and added the Inner Palace, Rites, and Wardrobe bureaus.

sentences.zh: 諸司諸典，自六品至九品而止。

translations.literal: All Directors and Custodians ranged from sixth to ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: All Directors and Custodians ranged from sixth to ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 其後復置貴妃。

translations.literal: Later the Noble Consort was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Noble Consort was restored.

sentences.zh: 淑儀、德儀、賢儀、順儀、婉儀、芳儀，各一人，正二品。

translations.literal: One each of Pure Consort, Virtuous Consort, Worthy Consort, Compliant Consort, Graceful Consort, and Fragrant Consort, upper second rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one each of Pure Consort, Virtuous Consort, Worthy Consort, Compliant Consort, Graceful Consort, and Fragrant Consort, all ranked at upper second grade.

sentences.zh: 掌教九御四德，率其屬以贊后禮。

translations.literal: They taught the Nine Inner Consorts the four virtues and led their subordinates to assist the empress in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: They taught the Nine Inner Consorts the four virtues and led their subordinates to assist the empress in ritual.

sentences.zh: 美人四人，正三品。

translations.literal: Four Beauties, upper third rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Beauties, ranked at upper third grade.

sentences.zh: 掌率女官脩祭祀、賓客之事。

translations.literal: They led palace women in managing sacrifices and guest affairs.
translations.idiomatic: They led palace women in managing sacrifices and guest affairs.

sentences.zh: 才人七人，正四品。

translations.literal: Seven Talented Ladies, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were seven Talented Ladies, ranked at upper fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 掌敍燕寢，理絲枲，以獻歲功。

translations.literal: They managed the inner chambers, processed silk and hemp, and presented the year's production.
translations.idiomatic: They managed the inner chambers, processed silk and hemp, and presented the year's production.

sentences.zh: 宮官尚宮局尚宮二人，正五品。

translations.literal: Two Inner Palace Chiefs of the Inner Palace Bureau, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Palace Bureau had two Inner Palace Chiefs, ranked at upper fifth grade.

sentences.zh: 六尚皆如之。

translations.literal: The Six Chiefs were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Chiefs in the other bureaus were the same.

sentences.zh: 掌導引中宮，總司記、司言、司簿、司闈。

translations.literal: They guided the inner palace and oversaw the Directors of Records, Speech, Registers, and Gates.
translations.idiomatic: They guided the inner palace and oversaw the Directors of Records, Speech, Registers, and Gates.

sentences.zh: 凡六尚事物出納文籍，皆涖其印署。

translations.literal: For all receipt and issue of documents and records among the Six Chiefs, they supervised sealing and signing.
translations.idiomatic: For all receipt and issue of documents and records among the Six Chiefs, they supervised sealing and signing.

sentences.zh: 有女史六人，掌執文書。

translations.literal: There were six Female Scribes who managed documents.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Female Scribes who managed documents.

sentences.zh: 司記二人，正六品；

translations.literal: Two Directors of Records, upper sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Directors of Records, ranked at upper sixth grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四司皆如之。

translations.literal: the twenty-four Directors were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Directors in the other bureaus were the same.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內文簿入出，錄為抄目，審付行焉。

translations.literal: They managed receipt and issue of inner palace documents, recorded them as copied lists, reviewed them, and sent them for execution.
translations.idiomatic: They managed receipt and issue of inner palace documents, recorded them as copied lists, reviewed them, and sent them for execution.

sentences.zh: 牒狀無違，然後加印。

translations.literal: When memorials and petitions were without violation, the seal was then applied.
translations.idiomatic: When memorials and petitions were without violation, the seal was then applied.

sentences.zh: 典記佐之。

translations.literal: Record Custodians assisted.
translations.idiomatic: Record Custodians assisted them.

sentences.zh: 典記二人，正七品；

translations.literal: Two Record Custodians, upper seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Record Custodians, ranked at upper seventh grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四典皆如之。

translations.literal: the twenty-four Custodians were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Custodians in the other bureaus were the same.

sentences.zh: 掌記二人，正八品；

translations.literal: Two Record Handlers, upper eighth rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were two Record Handlers, ranked at upper eighth grade;

sentences.zh: 二十四掌皆如之。

translations.literal: the twenty-four Handlers were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: the twenty-four Handlers in the other bureaus were the same.

sentences.zh: 司言、典言，各二人，掌承敕宣付。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Speech and Speech Custodians managed receipt of edicts and their promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Speech and Speech Custodians received edicts and promulgated them.

sentences.zh: 別鈔以授司閽傳外。

translations.literal: Separate copies were made and given to the Gate Director for transmission outside.
translations.idiomatic: Separate copies were made and given to the Gate Director for transmission outside.

sentences.zh: 掌言二人，掌宣傳，外司附奏受事者，奏聞；

translations.literal: Two Speech Handlers managed announcements; when outside offices submitted attached memorials for matters received, they reported them;
translations.idiomatic: Two Speech Handlers managed announcements; when outside offices submitted attached memorials for matters received, they reported them;

sentences.zh: 承敕處分，則錄所奏為案記。

translations.literal: when edicts were received for disposition, they recorded the memorials as case notes.
translations.idiomatic: when edicts were received for disposition, they recorded the memorials as case notes.

sentences.zh: 有女史四人。

translations.literal: There were four Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司簿、典簿、掌簿，各二人，掌女史以上名簿。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Registers, Register Custodians, and Register Handlers managed name registers of Female Scribes and above.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Registers, Register Custodians, and Register Handlers managed name registers of Female Scribes and above.

sentences.zh: 稟賜，則品別條錄為等。

translations.literal: For grain rations and gifts, they listed entries by rank into grades.
translations.idiomatic: For grain rations and gifts, they listed entries by rank into grades.

sentences.zh: 有女史六人。

translations.literal: There were six Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司闈六人，掌諸閤管鑰。

translations.literal: Six Directors of Gates managed keys for all inner chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Six Directors of Gates managed keys for all inner chambers.

sentences.zh: 典闈、掌闈，各六人，掌分涖啟閉。

translations.literal: Six each of Gate Custodians and Gate Handlers divided supervision of opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Six each of Gate Custodians and Gate Handlers divided supervision of opening and closing.

sentences.zh: 有女史四人。

translations.literal: There were four Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 尚儀局尚儀二人，掌禮儀起居。

translations.literal: Two Rites Chiefs of the Rites Bureau managed ceremonial protocol and daily activity.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites Bureau had two Rites Chiefs, who managed ceremonial protocol and daily activity.

sentences.zh: 總司籍、司樂、司賓、司贊。

translations.literal: They oversaw the Directors of Registers, Music, Guests, and Praise.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw the Directors of Registers, Music, Guests, and Praise.

sentences.zh: 司籍、典籍、掌籍，各二人，掌供御經籍。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Registers, Register Custodians, and Register Handlers managed supply of imperial classics.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Registers, Register Custodians, and Register Handlers managed supply of imperial classics.

sentences.zh: 分四部，部別為目，以時暴涼。

translations.literal: They divided them into four categories, each with its own catalogue, and aired them to cool at the proper season.
translations.idiomatic: They divided them into four categories, each with its own catalogue, and aired them to cool at the proper season.

sentences.zh: 教學則簿記課業，供奉几案、紙筆，皆預偫焉。

translations.literal: For instruction they recorded coursework; tables, paper, and brushes for attendance were all prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: For instruction they recorded coursework; tables, paper, and brushes for attendance were all prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 有女史十人。

translations.literal: There were ten Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司樂、典樂、掌樂，各四人，掌宮縣及諸樂陳布之儀，涖其閱習。

translations.literal: Four each of Directors of Music, Music Custodians, and Music Handlers managed palace music ensembles and the protocol for arranging all music, supervising their rehearsal.
translations.idiomatic: Four each of Directors of Music, Music Custodians, and Music Handlers managed palace music ensembles and the protocol for arranging all music, supervising their rehearsal.

sentences.zh: 有女史二人。

translations.literal: There were two Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司賓、典賓、掌賓，各二人，掌賓客朝見，受名以聞。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Guests, Guest Custodians, and Guest Handlers managed guest audiences, receiving names and reporting them.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Guests, Guest Custodians, and Guest Handlers managed guest audiences, receiving names and reporting them.

sentences.zh: 宴會，則具品數以授尚食；

translations.literal: At banquets they prepared numbers by rank and handed them to the Provisioner's Chief;
translations.idiomatic: At banquets they prepared numbers by rank and handed them to the Provisioner's Chief;

sentences.zh: 有賜物，與尚功涖給。

translations.literal: when there were gifts, they joined the Works Chief in supervising distribution.
translations.idiomatic: when there were gifts, they joined the Works Chief in supervising distribution.

sentences.zh: 有女史二人。

translations.literal: There were two Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司贊、典贊、掌贊，各二人，掌賓客朝見、宴食，贊相導引。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Praise, Praise Custodians, and Praise Handlers managed guest audiences and banquets, announcing and guiding.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Praise, Praise Custodians, and Praise Handlers managed guest audiences and banquets, announcing and guiding.

sentences.zh: 會日，引客立于殿庭，司言宣敕坐，然後引即席。

translations.literal: On the day of assembly, they led guests to stand in the hall courtyard; the Director of Speech proclaimed the edict to be seated, and then they led them to their places.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of assembly they led guests to stand in the hall courtyard; the Director of Speech proclaimed the edict to be seated, and then they led them to their places.

sentences.zh: 酒至，起再拜；

translations.literal: When wine arrived, they rose and bowed twice;
translations.idiomatic: When wine arrived, they rose and bowed twice;

sentences.zh: 食至，亦起。

translations.literal: when food arrived, they also rose.
translations.idiomatic: when food arrived, they also rose.

sentences.zh: 皆相其儀。

translations.literal: They all matched their ceremonial conduct.
translations.idiomatic: They all matched their ceremonial conduct.

sentences.zh: 彤史二人，正六品。

translations.literal: Two Vermilion Scribes, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Vermilion Scribes, ranked at upper sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 有女史二人。

translations.literal: There were two Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 尚服局尚服二人，掌供服用采章之數，總司寶、司衣、司飾、司仗。

translations.literal: Two Wardrobe Chiefs of the Wardrobe Bureau managed quantities of clothing, insignia, and colors supplied, and oversaw the Directors of Treasures, Garments, Adornments, and Implements.
translations.idiomatic: The Wardrobe Bureau had two Wardrobe Chiefs, who managed quantities of clothing, insignia, and colors supplied, and oversaw the Directors of Treasures, Garments, Adornments, and Implements.

sentences.zh: 司寶二人，掌神寶、受命寶、六寶及符契，皆識其行用，記以文簿。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Treasures managed the Spirit Treasure, Mandate Treasure, Six Treasures, and tally documents, knowing their use and recording them in written registers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Treasures managed the Spirit Treasure, Mandate Treasure, Six Treasures, and tally documents, knowing their use and recording them in written registers.

sentences.zh: 典寶、掌寶，各二人，凡出付皆旬別案記，還則朱書注入。

translations.literal: Two each of Treasure Custodians and Treasure Handlers: whenever items were issued, case notes were made every ten days; on return, entries were added in red ink.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Treasure Custodians and Treasure Handlers: whenever items were issued, case notes were made every ten days; on return, entries were added in red ink.

sentences.zh: 有女史四人。

translations.literal: There were four Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司衣、典衣、掌衣，各二人，掌宮內御服、首飾整比，以時進奉。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Garments, Garment Custodians, and Garment Handlers managed inner palace robes and head ornaments, arranging and presenting them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Garments, Garment Custodians, and Garment Handlers managed inner palace robes and head ornaments, arranging and presenting them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 有女史四人。

translations.literal: There were four Female Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Female Scribes.

sentences.zh: 司飾、典飾、掌飾，各二人，掌湯沐、巾櫛。

translations.literal: Two each of Directors of Adornments, Adornment Custodians, and Adornment Handlers managed bathing supplies, towels, and combs.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of Directors of Adornments, Adornment Custodians, and Adornment Handlers managed bathing supplies, towels, and combs.

sentences.zh: 凡供進，識其寒溫之節。
